test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error.**

options.text: Near death expereinces are stil near death.
Near death expriences are still near death.
Near death experiences are stil near deaath.
Near death experiences are still near death.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Near death experiences are still near death.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**experiences**" and "**death**".
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct with proper punctuation and capitalization.
 
• The word "**still**" is used appropriately to convey the continuation of the situation.
 
• The sentence is written in the present tense.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: The word "**expereinces**" is misspelled.
 
• Option 2: The word "**expriences**" is misspelled.
 
• Option 3: The word "**deaath**" is misspelled.
